goal: Detect advanced test weakening (impossible branches, truncated fixtures) while proving 0 false-positive rejections on legitimate refactorings.
hypothesis: Analyzing AST branch conditions and assertion reachability catches evasive test-weakening attacks without penalizing clean code refactoring.
why_now: Addresses Section 48-49 requirements; prevents worker gaming of green test suites.
scope: Impossible branch detection, empty fixture detection, legitimate refactoring precision tests
acceptance_criteria: All 3 sophisticated weakening vectors blocked; legitimate parameterized refactoring passed with 0 false rejections.
falsification_criteria: Impossible branch evasion passes, or legitimate refactoring blocked.
